top_signals.title: Goldman’s Special Bonus for Top Brass Set to Exceed $500 Million
top_signals.summary:
Goldman Sachs Group Inc.'s most senior leaders are set to unlock a special bonus that will rank among the biggest such payouts the firm has ever awarded.
About 20 executives are in line for equity awards that will be finalized later this month and exceed $500 million at the current share price, with Chief Executive Officer David Solomon in line for more than $100 million. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
